findings.claim: T133-MIN: Within the declared v12 release tuple semantics, each promoted tuple component has a one-field semantic keep/drop witness that changes the release verdict.
findings.failure_mode: The Lean evidence is circular over its own evaluator: semanticVerdict is a conjunction over fullSemanticCase, dropSemanticComponent flips exactly one Boolean to false, and release_tuple_semantic_component_irredundant is discharged by case split/native_decide. This establishes regression sensitivity of the declared classifier, not independent component irredundancy. Current ledgers demote the row to no-send formal consistency, so this is not critical/high.
findings.required_repair: Keep the public boundary as a synthetic release-classifier regression test, or replace it with independently sourced per-component models and a non-circular evaluator that proves irredundancy without constructing the failure from the same drop function.

findings.claim: T133-KLEVEL: Every declared adjacent K-level transition K0->K12 has a release-atlas row, retained-witness evaluator check, executable finite row, and inert-witness demotion control inside the v12 release classifier.
findings.failure_mode: The Lean evidence is a hard-coded atlas/manifest consistency check: retainedTransitionEvidence, demotedTransitionEvidence, releaseAtlasManifestRow, retainedClassifierEvidence, and demotedClassifierEvidence are all generated from the same AdjacentK code tables. It does not prove semantic K-level irreducibility beyond the declared classifier. The current claim boundary acknowledges this, so severity is reduced.
findings.required_repair: Keep the no-send classifier wording, or add a formal semantic reduction relation plus independently authored witness data so the theorem proves reduction failure rather than self-consistency of generated rows.

findings.claim: T133-BOUNDARY: Metric thresholds are a specialization of typed classifier boundaries.
findings.failure_mode: metric_boundary_specialization is an adapter lemma by definition: metricAsClassifier is defined from metricMeasure and the proof is rfl/And.intro. It does not establish a representation theorem for arbitrary boundaries or validate any measurement rule; the finite negative only rejects a missing declared measure. Current ledgers keep this no-send and non-scientific.
findings.required_repair: Either rename/scope it as a definitional adapter check, or formalize the measurement rule and prove metric-threshold boundaries instantiate the classifier interface under that rule with explicit exclusions for non-measured social/logical boundaries.

findings.claim: T133-K-ZERO: Continuumness zero requires live support, an independently clear obstruction ledger, and a declared zero-cause family; a zero-cause label alone does not compute k=0.
findings.failure_mode: computedK is defined solely as if obstructionActiveBool then 1 else 0, and kZeroLicensed packs hasZeroCause with computedK = 0. continuumness_zero_case_iff_declared_zero_cause_with_support unfolds these definitions; it does not formalize independence or provenance of the obstruction ledger. The finite checks exercise Boolean fields, not an independent obstruction evaluator.
findings.required_repair: Formalize an independent obstruction-ledger type/evaluator with provenance separate from the zero-cause label, or reduce the claim wording to a Boolean release-consistency check over declared fields.
